name: – Marta Temido, Adam Jarubas – Article 1 – § 1 – after point 3a; Directive 2001/18/EC – After Article 24ga – Am 134
title: REPORT on the proposal for a Directive of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Directives 2001/18/EC and 2010/53/EU as regards the placing on the market of genetically modified micro-organisms and the processing of organs
part_text: Article 24ga GMMs excluded from deliberate release into the environment 1. No authorisation shall be granted for the deliberate release into the environment of GMMs falling within any of the following categories: (a) mirror organisms, containing biological molecules with a chirality not naturally occurring in terrestrial life; (b) gene drive organisms capable of spreading genetic modifications through wild populations beyond the release site; (c) self-spreading viral constructs capable of replicating and spreading between organisms or across generations beyond the organism initially treated. 2. The Commission may add further categories of GMMs presenting comparable or greater risks through delegated acts. Such acts shall not weaken the protection provided for in this Article.
